simple: A cloud SIEM for detecting and investigating attacks. Collects logs from computers, sign-in systems, the cloud and SaaS services; detects threats using a rule library (formerly Attacker Behavior Analytics) and unusual user behavior (UEBA); has plain-language search for threat hunting, investigation and automated-response playbooks (SOAR), built-in threat intelligence, asset inventory and monitoring of resources visible from the internet. The Rapid7 agent on computers provides ready-made detections of suspicious processes and PowerShell commands, Office macros, password theft from memory (Mimikatz, LSASS dump) and persistence in the system; it also alerts if user credentials show up in public leaks. Logs are retained for 90 days. Ransomware protection is available for an extra fee.
